sentences.zh: 蠹國亂政，其事非一端。

translations.literal: Harming the state and disordering government—his offenses were not limited to one kind.
translations.idiomatic: Harming the state and disordering government—his offenses were not limited to one kind.

sentences.zh: 請乾斷以杜禍萌」。

translations.literal: I ask for decisive judgment to cut off the sprouting of calamity."
translations.idiomatic: I ask for decisive judgment to cut off the sprouting of calamity."

sentences.zh: 御史季振宜繼劾，亦及國祥、正學，並正宗貪賄營利諸事。

translations.literal: Censor Ji Zhenyi followed with a memorial, also implicating Guoxiang and Zhengxue, together with Zhengzong's taking bribes and seeking profit in various matters.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Ji Zhenyi followed with a memorial, also implicating Guoxiang and Zhengxue, together with Zhengzong's taking bribes and seeking profit in various matters.

sentences.zh: 正宗疏辨，略謂：「李昌祚為叛黨，裔介身為法司，何不早行糾參？

translations.literal: Zhengzong memorialized in his defense, stating in part: "Li Changzuo was of the rebel faction—Yijie himself was in the judiciary; why did he not memorialize against him early?
translations.idiomatic: Zhengzong memorialized in his defense, stating in part: "Li Changzuo was of the rebel faction—Yijie himself was in the judiciary; why did he not memorialize against him early?

sentences.zh: 例凡薦舉之官，在本任不職，追坐舉主。

translations.literal: By precedent, whenever an official who was recommended fails in his current post, the recommender is held accountable.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, whenever an official who was recommended fails in his current post, the recommender is held accountable.

sentences.zh: 國祥、羽明皆升任後得罪。

translations.literal: Guoxiang and Yuming both offended only after being promoted to higher posts.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxiang and Yuming both offended only after being promoted to higher posts.

sentences.zh: 縉彥序臣詩有曰'將明之才'，臣詩稿見存，縉彥序未見此語。」

translations.literal: Jinyan's preface to my poetry is said to contain the words "talent to govern and clarify"; my poetry manuscript still exists, and Jinyan's preface does not contain this phrase."
translations.idiomatic: Jinyan's preface to my poetry is said to contain the words "talent to govern and clarify"; my poetry manuscript still exists, and Jinyan's preface does not contain this phrase."

sentences.zh: 疏入，上奪正宗官，下王大臣會鞫；

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor stripped Zhengzong of office and sent the case down to the prince and great ministers for joint interrogation;
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor stripped Zhengzong of office and sent the case to the prince and great ministers for joint interrogation;

sentences.zh: 亦責裔介、振宜不早糾參，並奪官待質。

translations.literal: he also rebuked Yijie and Zhenyi for not memorializing early, and stripped both of office pending verification.
translations.idiomatic: he also rebuked Yijie and Zhenyi for not memorializing early, and stripped both of office pending verification.

sentences.zh: 旋議上裔介、振宜劾正宗罪狀鞫實者十一事，罪當絞。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the deliberation submitted upward found eleven counts in Yijie and Zhenyi's memorial against Zhengzong substantiated by interrogation; the offense warranted strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the deliberation found eleven counts in Yijie and Zhenyi's memorial against Zhengzong substantiated by interrogation; the offense warranted strangulation.

sentences.zh: 上斥「正宗性質暴戾，器量褊淺，持論偏私，處事執謬。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him: "Zhengzong's nature is violent and harsh, his capacity narrow and shallow, his opinions partial and private, and his handling of affairs stubbornly mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him: "Zhengzong's nature is violent and harsh, his capacity narrow and shallow, his opinions partial and private, and his handling of affairs stubbornly mistaken.

sentences.zh: 惟事沽名好勝，罔顧大體，罪戾滋甚。

translations.literal: He cares only for reputation and rivalry, heedless of the larger interest, and his offenses grow ever worse.
translations.idiomatic: He cares only for reputation and rivalry, heedless of the larger interest, and his offenses grow ever worse.

sentences.zh: 從寬免死，籍家產之半，入旗，不許回籍」。

translations.literal: Showing leniency he is spared death; half his household property is registered and confiscated; he enters the banner and is not permitted to return to his native place."
translations.idiomatic: Showing leniency he is spared death; half his household property is confiscated; he enters the banner and is not permitted to return to his native place."

sentences.zh: 十八年，聖祖即位，以世祖遺詔及正宗罪狀，當置重典，愍其衰老，貸之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Shengzu ascended the throne, in view of the Shizu's testamentary edict and Zhengzong's offenses he ought to have received severe punishment; pitying his age, the emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Shengzu ascended the throne, in view of the Shizu's testamentary edict and Zhengzong's offenses he ought to have received severe punishment; pitying his age, the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 未幾病卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 張縉彥，河南新鄭人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jinyan was a native of Xinzheng in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jinyan was a native of Xinzheng in Henan.

sentences.zh: 明崇禎進士，自知縣行取授主事。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the Chongzhen reign of the Ming, he was selected from magistrate service and appointed a section chief.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the Ming Chongzhen reign, he was selected from magistrate service and appointed a section chief.

sentences.zh: 再授編修，擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was again appointed compiler and promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed compiler and promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，詣固山額真葉臣軍前納款，福王授以總督，乃遁去。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he went to the army of gushan ejen Yechen to submit; the Prince of Fu appointed him governor, whereupon he fled.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he went to the army of gushan ejen Yechen to submit; the Prince of Fu appointed him governor, whereupon he fled.

sentences.zh: 既，复受洪承疇招降。

translations.literal: Later he again accepted Hong Chengchou's summons to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again accepted Hong Chengchou's summons to surrender.

sentences.zh: 九年，以薦下吏部考核。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, on recommendation, he was sent down to the Ministry of Personnel for assessment.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on recommendation, he was referred to the Ministry of Personnel for assessment.

sentences.zh: 十年，授山東右布政。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十七年，甄別三品以上大臣，降授江南徽寧道。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when ministers of the third rank and above were screened, he was demoted and appointed to the Huining Circuit in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, when ministers of the third rank and above were screened, he was demoted and appointed to the Huining Circuit in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 裔介劾正宗，詞連縉彥，奪官逮訊。

translations.literal: When Yijie memorialized against Zhengzong, his language implicated Jinyan; Jinyan was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: When Yijie memorialized against Zhengzong, his language implicated Jinyan; Jinyan was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 御史蕭震疏劾縉彥編刻無聲戲，自稱「不死英雄」，惑人心，害風俗。

translations.literal: Censor Xiao Zhen memorialized that Jinyan had compiled and printed Voiceless Plays, calling himself an "undying hero," bewildering people's hearts and harming custom.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xiao Zhen memorialized that Jinyan had compiled and printed Voiceless Plays, calling himself an "undying hero," bewildering people's hearts and harming custom.

sentences.zh: 王大臣會鞫，論斬，上命貰死，籍其家，流徙寧古塔。

translations.literal: The prince and great ministers jointly interrogated the case and sentenced him to decapitation; the emperor ordered his life spared, his household registered and confiscated, and him exiled to Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: The prince and great ministers jointly interrogated the case and sentenced him to decapitation; the emperor ordered his life spared, his household property confiscated, and him exiled to Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 尋死於戍所。

translations.literal: Before long he died in exile.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died in exile.

sentences.zh: 論曰：剛林相太宗，與範文程、希福並命，祁充格掌記室，於創業宜皆有功。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Ganglin served the Taizong, and together with Fan Wencheng and Xifu received concurrent appointments; Qi Chongge managed the secretariat—in founding the enterprise they ought all to have had merit.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Ganglin served the Taizong, and together with Fan Wencheng and Xifu received concurrent appointments; Qi Chongge managed the secretariat—in founding the enterprise they ought all to have had merit.

sentences.zh: 銓故明相，諳故事，與名夏皆善佔對。

translations.literal: Quan was a former Ming grand secretary, versed in precedent, and both he and Mingxia were skilled at impromptu replies.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was a former Ming grand secretary, versed in precedent, and both he and Mingxia were skilled at impromptu replies.

sentences.zh: 名夏勸進雖不用，以此邀峻擢。

translations.literal: Although Mingxia's urging to advance the throne was not adopted, by this he sought steep promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Although Mingxia's urging to advance the throne was not adopted, by this he sought steep promotion.

sentences.zh: 之遴、正宗各有所援引，知當時亦頗用事。

translations.literal: Zhilin and Zhengzong each had their own protégés; one knows that at the time they too wielded considerable influence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhilin and Zhengzong each had their own protégés; one knows that at the time they too wielded considerable influence.

sentences.zh: 際初運，都高位，而不足以堪之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty's fortune they all held high rank, yet were not equal to bearing it.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the dynasty's fortune they all held high rank, yet were not equal to bearing it.

sentences.zh: 誅夷削奪，曾莫之惜。

translations.literal: Execution, stripping, and confiscation were applied without sparing them.
translations.idiomatic: Execution, stripping, and confiscation were applied without sparing them.

sentences.zh: 正宗傾名夏，亦不免於罪，尤可鑑矣。

translations.literal: Zhengzong brought down Mingxia, yet could not himself escape guilt—this is especially worth taking as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengzong brought down Mingxia, yet could not himself escape guilt—this is especially worth taking as a warning.
